name: Sweet Potato Fritters with Smoky Tahini Sauce, Broccoli & Cauliflower

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb sweet potatoes
3 crowns broccoli
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 ½ lemons
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Peel and coarsely grate sweet potatoes. Transfer to a colander and sprinkle with salt. Place the colander in a bowl to catch the excess moisture and set aside.

Separate broccoli and cauliflower into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Divide both between two baking sheet pans, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until the veggies are fork-tender, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemons into a small bowl. Add tahini, water, maple syrup, and spices, then whisk to combine the tahini sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup tahini
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
chili powder
¾ tsp smoked paprika
salt

instructions.primary_message: Using paper towels or a clean cloth, squeeze excess moisture from the grated sweet potato, then place in a large bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the sweet potato along with eggs, flour, soy sauce, and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine the batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 eggs
chili powder
salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp cumin, ground

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Working in batches, use a scant ¼-cup measure to drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; flatten slightly with the back of a spoon. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.

Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in a clean large bowl (reserving a small handful for serving) along with half of the tahini sauce. (Reserve remaining tahini sauce for serving.)
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven. Add to the bowl with the dill and tahini sauce along with raisins and pumpkin seeds. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup raisins
⅓ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide broccoli, cauliflower, and fritters between plates or bowls. Drizzle fritters with remaining tahini sauce, sprinkle with reserved dill, and enjoy!
